name: Paradigm Foodworks Inc
old_description: Shipping to US addresses only. Free shipping at $75.00 for orders within the contiguous 48 US states.
about:
Paradigm Foodworks Inc operates from Lake Oswego, Oregon, where it was founded in 1981. The company is woman-owned and has been crafting small-batch food products for over four decades.

The manufacturer produces a range of artisanal condiments and sauces, including charcuterie condiments, dessert sauces, fruit and berry spreads, barbecue and grill sauces, mustards and horseradish, pizza and pasta sauces, salad dressings, salsa and enchilada sauces, as well as Indian and Asian fusion sauce lines. Production is described as small-batch crafting, though facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Paradigm Foodworks sells directly to consumers through its e-commerce website, shipping to addresses within the contiguous United States. The company does not publicly list wholesale, food-service, or industrial customers, so its primary customer type appears to be retail consumers seeking specialty pantry items.

The company emphasizes its woman-owned status and its heritage of small-batch production since 1981 as distinguishing factors. No further claims about differentiation or founding mission are provided in the available sources.
